name: Kuryou Nozomi
source:
Possessing an androgynous beauty, Nozomi is a mysterious girl.
She's energetic, talkative, and very touchy-feely.

[From [url=https://sekaiproject.com/nie-no-hakoniwa]Sekai Project[/url]]

Surname: "九領" (Kuryou)
九 (ku or kyuu): This character means "nine."
領 (ryou): This character means "territory," "domain," or "jurisdiction."
Combined, "九領" can be interpreted as "nine territories" or "ninth domain."

Given name: "希" (Nozomi)
希 (ki or nozomi): This character means "hope," "wish," or "rare."

[spoiler]Nozomi, born from the Kotori-bako, was a product of Shiki Yorimichi's desperate wish. Following the disastrous wedding event, he offered Kyouko's ruined womb to the Box, seeking an "ideal" daughter. This resulted in a being that fused the qualities of both Shiki daughters: Touko's brilliance, uncanny appearance, physical capabilities, and Kyouko's fertility. Additionally, Nozomi inherited fragments of Kyouko's personality and memories.[/spoiler]
